title: Design Resilience Patterns for ASP.NET Core
description: Use Polly for retries, circuit breakers, timeouts, and fallback policies in distributed systems.

data.text: Your ASP.NET Core service calls three downstream APIs. One is frequently unavailable. Design resilience so failures do not cascade.
Resilience patterns protect your system from downstream failures. Polly is the standard library for implementing these in .NET.

data.title: Polly Policies
items: **Circuit Breaker**: Stop calling a failing service after N failures
**Timeout**: Fail fast if an operation takes too long
**Fallback**: Return cached or default data when the real call fails
**Bulkhead**: Limit concurrent calls to protect resources

data.title: Polly Resilience Pipeline
data.code:
builder.Services.AddHttpClient<IOrderService, OrderService>()
    .AddPolicyHandler(Policy.TimeoutAsync<HttpResponseMessage>(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3)))
    .AddPolicyHandler(RetryPolicy<HttpResponseMessage>
        .Handle<HttpRequestException>()
        .WaitAndRetryAsync(3, retry => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, retry))))
    .AddPolicyHandler(CircuitBreakerPolicy<HttpResponseMessage>
        .Handle<HttpRequestException>()
        .CircuitBreakerAsync(5, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30)));

// Fallback example
var fallback = Policy<HttpResponseMessage>
    .Handle<HttpRequestException>()
    .Or<TimeoutRejectedException>()
    .FallbackAsync(
        fallbackAction: _ => Task.FromResult(new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK)
        {
            Content = new StringContent("\{\"cached\":true\}")
        }),
        onFallbackAsync: ex => Task.CompletedTask);

data.text: A circuit breaker has three states: Closed (normal), Open (failing fast), and Half-Open (testing recovery).

data.title: Custom Circuit Breaker Monitoring
Resilience Best Practice
data.text: Apply resilience at the boundary of your system: HTTP clients, message consumers, and database calls. Do not sprinkle try/catch everywhere.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Polly provides production-grade resilience policies for .NET
Retry with exponential backoff handles transient failures
Circuit breakers prevent cascading failures across services
Timeout policies protect threads from hanging indefinitely
Fallbacks give users degraded but functional responses
data.takeaway: Resilience is not optional in distributed systems. Polly makes it straightforward to add retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts to ASP.NET Core HTTP clients.
